summary: This note describes Oh Yeah, a 1962 album by jazz musician Charles Mingus. The album was recorded in 1961. Mingus, mainly known as a bassist and composer, sings on three of the cuts and plays piano throughout.
one_line: Oh Yeah is a 1962 jazz album by Charles Mingus, recorded in 1961, featuring his vocals and piano playing.
